subject: Greenline benchmarking: traffic model, acceptance criteria, and run artifacts
messages:
From: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@greenline.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-20 15:02 UTC
Subject: Benchmark window & traffic profile for onboarding acceptance

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the demo — impressed with the latency numbers you presented. We need to schedule an official benchmark / acceptance window as part of the onboarding checklist so procurement can sign off. A couple of asks to make the run meaningful for our engineers:

- We'll supply a production-mirrored traffic profile (mostly short-chat prompts, 60% single-turn, 40% multi-turn average length ~150 tokens). Can you confirm what formats you prefer (JSON lines ok)?
- Target acceptance: p95 latency <= 250ms for single-turn, sustained 200 RPS for 30m; ability to absorb 5-min bursts to 500 RPS with no error-rate >0.5%. Is that a realistic starting target?
- We need the final artifacts (metrics, latency histograms, and raw request/response samples) delivered to our secure drive and a Grafana snapshot for auditors.

Can you propose a short runbook and a couple of dates next week? We prefer weekdays in the PST window.

Rajiv
Principal Engineer, Integrations
Greenline Health
[Attachment: greenline_traffic_profile.json (application/json)]

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@greenline.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-21 09:14 UTC
Subject: Re: Benchmark window & traffic profile for onboarding acceptance

Rajiv — thanks, that traffic profile looks good. Short answer: JSON lines is perfect. High-level plan attached (redwood_benchmark-runbook.md). Key points below and next steps.

Summary runbook (high level)
- Pre-check (Day -1): create test API key, open VPC peering, confirm sample payloads ingestion.
- Baseline run (Day 0, 30m): 50 RPS ramp to 200 RPS steady; capture p50/p95/p99.
- Burst window (Day 0, 1 hr after baseline): simulate 3x 5-min bursts up to 500 RPS; verify error-rate and tail latency.
- Post-run artifacts: consolidated JSON results, Grafana snapshots, raw request IDs with hashes, telemetry-schema.csv.

We can run a canary on Wednesday (PST) morning if that works. For the acceptance thresholds you suggested — p95 <= 250ms and burst resilience to 500 RPS — we believe those are achievable on the dedicated pool we plan to allocate. Ben will own the run configuration and Karthik will coordinate telemetry export.

Action items for Greenline (please):
- Share final traffic file (jsonl) and a short list of top-10 sample prompts (for trace sampling).
- Provide a test account or allow our runner IPs in your allowlist.

Attachments: redwood_benchmark-runbook.md

—
Monica Patel
Customer Success – Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@greenline.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-22 16:30 UTC
Subject: Re: Benchmark window & traffic profile for onboarding acceptance

Adding the technical run notes so everyone has visibility.

Run configuration (internal)
- Workload: JSONL sampling from greenline_traffic_profile.json (supplied).
- Concurrency model: open loop with Poisson arrivals to mirror production variability.
- Keys: use a dedicated test key with 1:1 token limits; KV cache disabled for first baseline, enabled for burst tests to validate cache benefit.
- Quantization profile: int8-opt on the s-series model variant (we'll list exact model in the runbook).

Acceptance targets (proposal)
- Steady-state: sustain 200 RPS for 30 minutes with p95 <= 250ms, p99 <= 420ms, total error-rate < 0.25%.
- Burst: support 5-minute bursts to 500 RPS with error-rate < 0.5% and no sustained p95 regressions > 300ms.
- Cost telemetry: token-usage per minute and per-request cost estimate exported.

Artifacts we'll produce
- load-run-20280727-results.json (full time-series), grafana-snapshot-20280727.png, and a short play-by-play in the mutual-action-plan-greenline.docx.

Ill kick off the baseline on 2028-07-27 16:00 UTC unless someone flags a schedule conflict.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: run-config.yml (text)]

Rajiv

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@greenline.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-28 18:04 UTC
Subject: Re: Benchmark window & traffic profile for onboarding acceptance

Rajiv — posting the final run summary and artifacts. TL;DR: acceptance PASSED per agreed thresholds. Details below and attachments in Drive.

Run highlights (see attachments):
- Baseline: sustained 200 RPS for 30m; p95 = 230ms, p99 = 405ms, error-rate = 0.12%.
- Burst window: three 5-min bursts to 520 RPS peak; error-rate max = 0.38% during burst transitions, p95 stable under 260ms; no systemic retries observed.
- Cost telemetry: average token cost within expected envelope; detailed breakdown in load-run-20280727-results.json.

Artifacts delivered:
- load-run-20280727-results.json (time-series + per-request summaries)
- grafana-snapshot-20280727.png (dashboard panels for latency, error rate, throughput)
- mutual-action-plan-greenline.docx (next steps and rollout runway)

Next steps we propose:
1) Greenline sign-off on the run (Procurement can mark as acceptance evidence in DocuSign).
2) Schedule a short post-mortem (30 min) to review telemetry and any small optimizations for caching/quantization.
3) Move to steady production onboarding on the dedicated pool next week after legal completes the SLA doc.

If youre good, Laura can push the artifacts to the evidence portal and well close the onboarding benchmark milestone.

Thanks everyone for the fast turnaround.

—Monica
Customer Success – Redwood Inference
[Attachments: load-run-20280727-results.json (application/json), grafana-snapshot-20280727.png (image/png), mutual-action-plan-greenline.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]
